core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers a user-friendly espresso machine that offers a café-like experience without requiring professional barista skills. He values sleek, modern designs with stainless-steel finishes and is interested in features like adjustable pressure, built-in milk frothers, and ease of use.
core_memory.user_additional_questions: Michael is asking detailed questions about the Aether ES-300 espresso machine, including brewing frequency, cleaning complexity, and footprint size. He wants to ensure it fits his kitchen counter and matches his daily routine.
core_memory.user_kitchen_space_concern: Michael is concerned about the footprint of the Aether ES-300 in relation to his existing kitchen counter setup. He wants to mentally prepare for potential rearrangements and is seeking clear, precise dimensions to avoid 'kitchen Tetris' stress.
core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry: Michael is inquiring about warranty policies for coffee machines, especially for higher-end models. He has had negative experiences with short warranty periods from other brands and is looking for a more reliable, customer-friendly policy.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature consistency, especially after having issues with drip machines that don't heat sufficiently. He wants to know if your espresso machines offer adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee.
